issues.description: Script uses XMLHttpRequest to fetch external code and executes it via a[a][a](x.responseText), which is equivalent to eval(). This allows remote code execution from arbitrary URLs.
issues.recommendation: Remove dynamic code loading and execution. Only load trusted, version-pinned libraries via @require.

issues.description: Script uses eval()-like construct (a[a][a]) to execute fetched code, which is highly dangerous.
issues.recommendation: Avoid eval and similar constructs. Use static code only.

issues.description: Script makes network requests to third-party server (ksw2-moomoo.glitch.me) and potentially other arbitrary URLs via loadModule.
issues.recommendation: Restrict network requests to trusted domains and avoid sending user data.

issues.description: Script grants unsafeWindow, which exposes privileged script context to the page and increases risk of privilege escalation.
Script uses a highly obfuscated eval pattern (a[a][a]) and indirect code execution.
issues.recommendation: Remove obfuscation and indirect code execution.

issues.description: Script loads third-party libraries via @require from greasyfork.org and code.jquery.com, but also from greasyfork.org user scripts (scijs from ksw2-center) which may not be official or version-pinned.
issues.recommendation: Pin versions and only use official, trusted sources for dependencies.

issues.description: Script grants multiple GM_* permissions (GM_getTabs, GM_getTab, GM_saveTab) which may not be used securely.
issues.recommendation: Minimize granted permissions to only those required.

issues.description: Script manipulates innerHTML and removes elements, but does not sanitize user input. Potential DOM XSS risk.
issues.recommendation: Sanitize all user input before inserting into DOM.

issues.description: Script listens for keyboard events and disables space bar scrolling on .io sites. No evidence of keylogger behavior, but potential for privacy abuse if extended.
issues.recommendation: Do not collect or transmit keyboard input.

details: Keyboard event listener (space bar prevention only, not keylogging)

script_name: Lift Web Restrictions: .io Game Mods (MooMoo.io/Krunker.io/..), Ad Link Bypasser, Adblock, & MORE!
summary: This userscript poses severe security risks, including remote code execution via dynamic fetching and eval, data exfiltration to third-party servers, code obfuscation, excessive permissions, and DOM XSS potential. It is NOT safe for use.
